newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee cuts gains, cocoa nears resistance.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee cuts gains, cocoa nears resistance.

text.p: COFFEE - Gaps higher as expected but fails to keep early gains as sellers emerge. July up $15 at $2,615 at 1019 GMT after a high of $2,660. COCOA - Up with July moving towards key resistance at 1,050 stg. Up 12 at 1,044 stg. SUGAR - Thinly traded with prices hovering within a tight band. Aug up 80 cents at $324.70 but rest mixed.
